verses.pali: “Tayome, bhikkhave, dhammā attabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti, parabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti, ubhayabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti.
verses.english: “These three things, mendicants, lead to hurting yourself, hurting others, and hurting both.
Bad conduct by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo dhammā attabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti, parabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti, ubhayabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These are three things that lead to hurting yourself, hurting others, and hurting both.

verses.pali: Tayome, bhikkhave, dhammā nevattabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti, na parabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti, na ubhayabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These three things, mendicants, don’t lead to hurting yourself, hurting others, or hurting both.
Good conduct by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo dhammā nevattabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti, na parabyābādhāyapi saṁvattanti, na ubhayabyābādhāyapi saṁvattantī”ti.
verses.english: These are three things that don’t lead to hurting yourself, hurting others, or hurting both.”
